body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Prague, Czechia. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 4 km. It starts at Lobkowicz Palace, Jiřská 3, 119 00 Praha 1-Hradčany, Czechia. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Lobkowicz Palace. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Embark on an in-app audio journey designed for adventurers and culture enthusiasts keen on delving into the heart of Prague. With your ticket to Lobkowicz Palace included, start your self-guided exploration where history meets luxury.
>
> Note! While entrance to Lobkowicz Palace is part of the package, an audio guide inside the palace is not included, encouraging a seamless adventure into the city's cobblestoned embraces.
>
> Starting at Lobkowicz Palace, this walking journey guides through cobbled streets and grandiose squares, ending in the mesmerizing spectacle of the Astronomical Clock at the Old Town Hall. The route unfolds like a treasure map, with tales lurking around each corner and behind the facades of majestic monuments. You will traverse across the fairy-tale appeal of Golden Lane, wade through the myths of Prague Castle, and stride along the iconic Charles Bridge, enriched by encounters with the John Lennon Wall and Kampa Island's idyllic allure.
>
> Be prepared to be swept off your feet by the time-defying stories that thrive within the St. Vitus Cathedral and the hushed whispers of the Clementinum. As you cross this mythical city, anticipate breathtaking panoramas from Charles Bridge and the profound animation of the Astronomical Clock as it springs to life.
>
> This tour promises more than just sightseeing—it offers a series of unforgettable experiences that sear into memory, ensuring your walk through Prague is one painted with awe and wonder.

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €22.77. It was rated 4.7 out of 5 from 23 ratings and 13 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
